blogs.title: Dear Mom-Dad, now that I am in my late 20s, I wish you knew these secrets about my personal life.
blogs.title_hi: प्रिय माता-पिता, अब जब मैं अपने 20 के दशक के उत्तरार्ध में हूं, काश कि आप मेरे निजी जीवन के बारे में इन रहस्यों को जानते।
blogs.content: I have studied in a reputed school and graduated from a top college. I have a decent job. I travel in every few months, read books and go out with my friends. Dear Parents, all I want to convey is that I have also some amount of experience (both bad and good) in these 28 years of my existence, which has built my perception about life. There is not even an iota of doubt about the unconditional love you have for me. However, a few of your beliefs have forced me to keep a few secrets from you. I wish I could confess those and pour my heart out in front of you.

blogs.title: 4 Easy Steps to Impress A Girl - Try this Now !!!
blogs.title_hi: एक लड़की को इम्प्रेस करने के 4 आसान उपाय - अब इसे आजमाएं !!!
blogs.content:
If you really want to know how to get a girlfriend, the quickest shortcut is discovering how to impress a girl.

 

When you know how to impress a girl, or more broadly, how to impress girls generally, you know how to make yourself attractive to them.

Once a girl is impressed by you, you have to work far less hard to get her to interested more romantically in you.

 

You may not think you’re impressive now, but all you need to do is follow the steps below, and you’ll have solved how to impress a girl with impressive easy.

I recommend reading through all of these 4 steps to find your absolute favorites…

 

Why Is Knowing How To Impress A Girl So Important?

 

The introduction really spells this out for you: if you want a girl to like you, it’s much easier to first get her impressed by you.

 

If she is impressed, she’s far more likely to find you attractive and to be receptive to your interest.

 

If you learn how to show off what is impressive about you, you also build up more confidence in yourself and more assertiveness about how you feel, which is again, far more attractive to most girls.

 

All in all, it’s easier for you to get a girlfriend and find romantic success if you learn how to impress girls and how to be impressive yourself.

blogs.title: Science says you sleep better if you have a loving partner!
blogs.title_hi: विज्ञान का कहना है कि यदि आप एक प्यार करने वाले साथी हैं तो आप बेहतर सोते हैं!
blogs.content:
​The science behind your goodnight sleep.

Being in a healthy relationship has several benefits, and one of these is that your snoozing hours are peaceful and uninterrupted every night. According to a study published in the journal of Social Psychological and Personal Science, people tend to sleep better if they feel their partner is responsive to their needs.

blogs.title: Safety tips for women while travelling alone in Cabs at Night!
blogs.title_hi: रात में कैब्स में अकेले यात्रा करते समय महिलाओं के लिए सुरक्षा युक्तियाँ!
blogs.content:
Generally, it’s safer now to travel with Ola/Uber or any other cab service but after few incidents that rocked the nation. The owners have already taken necessary precaution for screening the drivers, before offering them a license to drive for their company. However, such is a human psychology that you never know what might instigate them.

 

With that in mind, the best thing you can do while travelling in cabs is letting someone know about your travelling details. It can be anyone in your family or friends or someone you know who resides on the route you are travelling. It is mandatory for drivers to have their ID’s displayed on the dashboard at all times. You can note down the details, along with the cab details and message it to someone.

blogs.title: Clever Ways To Avoid a Hangover
blogs.title_hi: एक हैंगओवर से बचने के लिए चालाक तरीके
blogs.content:
A hangover is the experience of various unpleasant physiological and psychological effects following the consumption of alcohol, such as wine, beer, and distilled spirits. Hangovers can last for several hours or for more than 24 hours. Typical symptoms of a hangover may include a headache, drowsiness, concentration problems, dry mouth, dizziness, fatigue, gastrointestinal distress (e.g., vomiting), the absence of hunger, depression, sweating, nausea, hyper-excitability, and anxiety.

While the causes of a hangover are still poorly understood, several factors are known to be involved including acetaldehyde accumulation, changes in the immune system and glucose metabolism, dehydration, metabolic acidosis, disturbed prostaglandin synthesis, increased cardiac output, vasodilation, sleep deprivation and malnutrition. Beverage-specific effects of additives or by-products such as congeners in alcoholic beverages also play an important role. The symptoms occur typically after the intoxicating effect of the alcohol begins to wear off, generally the morning after a night of heavy drinking.

Though many possible remedies and folk cures have been suggested, there is no compelling evidence to suggest that any are effective for preventing or treating alcohol hangover. Avoiding alcohol or drinking in moderation are the most effective ways to avoid a hangover. The socioeconomic consequences and health risks of alcohol hangover include workplace absenteeism, impaired job performance, reduced productivity and poor academic achievement. A hangover may also compromise potentially dangerous daily activities such as driving a car or operating heavy machinery.

source: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Hangover
